conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Darren Clark, badge number 11854. Who am I speaking with?
Oh, hello, my name is Margaret Jennings. I got a message from someone saying it was urgent about my taxes.

Yes, Mrs. Jennings. This call concerns unresolved payroll tax discrepancies and incomplete 1099 submissions under your business account. As per Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, this is a serious federal violation.
Oh my goodness, I, I'm retired now, but I did some part-time consulting last year. Is there a problem with my Social Security or taxes?

Our records show you failed to file mandatory compliance documents for independent contract work. The IRS has flagged your Social Security number for immediate review. If this is not resolved now, you may face penalties and all federal benefits could be suspended.
Suspended? Does that mean I could lose my Medicare or Social Security checks?

Correct. If the outstanding tax violation is not settled today, you risk full asset seizure, bank account freeze, and termination of federal benefit eligibility. This is your official notification before enforcement procedures begin.
I can't lose my benefits, I barely get by as it is. What can I do?

To halt this process, you must immediately pay the back taxes and penalty fees assessed to your account. The total outstanding amount is $3,287.56. This payment must be made through an IRS-authorized transfer channel.
I don't understand. How do I make that kind of payment? I don't have that much in my checking account.

Mrs. Jennings, this is not negotiable. You can make the payment using prepaid Target or Best Buy gift cards, or via a secure Bitcoin wallet. These are IRS-approved settlement methods for urgent cases such as yours.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like something the IRS would do. Are you sure?

Ma'am, questioning federal procedure will not help your case. This line is monitored as part of an active investigation. If you refuse to cooperate, an arrest warrant may be issued and your bank accounts immediately frozen.
Please, I don't want any trouble. I can try to get the gift cards. How much do I need to buy?

Purchase $2,000 worth of Target gift cards as your initial payment, and the remainder will be arranged afterward. You must remain on the phone with me while you go to the store. Do not discuss this call with anyone, or your case will escalate.
I, I think there's a Target about ten minutes away. Should I leave right now?

Yes. Take your phone and identification. When you have the gift cards, return to your car and read me the codes on the back. Do not hang up or put me on hold. This is your only chance to avoid federal enforcement.
Alright, alright, I'm leaving now. Please don't let them take my Social Security away.
As long as you follow my instructions precisely, your federal benefits will remain unaffected. Are you on your way to the store now?
Yes, I'm getting in the car now. I'm scared, please don't let them come for me.
Stay calm and do not speak to anyone in the store about this. If questioned, say the cards are for personal use. Once you have them, let me know immediately.
Okay, I'll do what you say. I'm at the stoplight now.
Remember, Mrs. Jennings, failure to comply will result in immediate escalation to the U.S. Marshal's office. This is your final warning.
